fileNodes.name: deps.py
fileNodes.summary: FastAPI dependency layer providing JWT bearer authentication, role-based access guards, and ownership/enrollment assertion helpers shared by every router.

fileNodes.name: agent.py
fileNodes.summary: POST /agent/run endpoint that validates agent intents and dispatches pipeline execution to the background task runner, returning a started-task result immediately.

fileNodes.name: agent_ops.py
fileNodes.summary: Observability endpoints listing agent tasks, inter-agent messages and runs, fronted by a stale-task reaper that fails tasks stuck in 'started' beyond the time budget.

fileNodes.name: auth.py
fileNodes.summary: Registration and login endpoints that hash passwords, create User rows plus Teacher/Student profiles, and issue JWT-backed TokenResponses.

fileNodes.name: courses.py
fileNodes.summary: Course router covering creation, role-scoped listing, enrollment, document upload/listing/status, and cascading deletes (document, contents, whole course) with audit logging and on-disk file cleanup.

fileNodes.name: curriculum.py
fileNodes.summary: Read-only curriculum endpoints serving generated chapters and topics (with objectives and prerequisites) to authorized teachers and enrolled students.

fileNodes.name: lessons.py
fileNodes.summary: Lesson endpoints that perform fast authorization checks, dispatch asynchronous lesson generation through the background task runner, and serve generated lessons to authorized viewers.

fileNodes.name: logs.py
fileNodes.summary: Teacher-only audit-log listing endpoint returning the most recent audit entries for the operations view.

fileNodes.name: quizzes.py
fileNodes.summary: Quiz lifecycle router: async quiz generation, answer-safe retrieval, and submission which persists attempt/answer rows before launching the grading chain in the background.

fileNodes.name: students.py
fileNodes.summary: Student analytics endpoints (profile, performance, mastery, recommendations, preferences) with self-or-owning-teacher authorization and a default-course fallback.

fileNodes.name: study_plans.py
fileNodes.summary: Study-plan read endpoints returning the active plan (highest version) with its daily items, authorized for the owning student or their teacher.

fileNodes.name: users.py
fileNodes.summary: Teacher-only user directory search over name/email that joins Student rows to expose grade level and daily study minutes for enrollment pickers.

fileNodes.name: session.py
fileNodes.summary: Database bootstrap: resolves and connect-probes the PostgreSQL URL (fail-fast, Postgres-only), exposes SessionLocal/get_db/session_scope helpers plus ID generators and init/reset routines including pgvector extension setup.

fileNodes.name: api.py
fileNodes.summary: Complete Pydantic v2 API contract layer: request/response models for auth, courses, documents, curriculum, study plans, lessons, quizzes, grading results, performance/mastery, recommendations, and agent observability payloads.

fileNodes.name: jwt.py
fileNodes.summary: Minimal JWT helper pair for issuing expiring HS-signed access tokens and decoding them during request authentication.

fileNodes.name: passwords.py
fileNodes.summary: bcrypt password hashing and constant-time verification wrappers used by registration and login.

fileNodes.name: runner.py
fileNodes.summary: Background task runner: persists AgentTask rows, submits pipeline execution to a ThreadPoolExecutor whose workers build their own sessions/runtime, and guarantees failure marking on crashes.

fileNodes.name: lesson_agent.py
fileNodes.summary: Generates levelled lesson content for a curriculum topic by combining RAG-retrieved textbook chunks, learning objectives and the student profile into a schema-validated LLM request, then persists the resulting Lesson row.

fileNodes.name: config.py
fileNodes.summary: Central pydantic-settings configuration loaded from the repo-root .env: app metadata, PostgreSQL URL, OpenRouter LLM/embedding settings, JWT secrets, RAG limits and retry knobs.

fileNodes.name: base.py
fileNodes.summary: Defines the provider-agnostic LLM contract: a request envelope pairing a prompt with its JSON schema, and the abstract LLMProvider interface every chat/embedding backend implements.

fileNodes.name: mock.py
fileNodes.summary: Deterministic offline LLM provider: seeded generators fabricate curricula, lessons, quizzes, grades and recommendations without network access, plus hash-based pseudo-embeddings for fully reproducible runs.

fileNodes.name: openai_compatible.py
fileNodes.summary: Production provider speaking the OpenAI wire protocol against OpenRouter: JSON-schema-constrained chat generation plus dimension-validated embeddings, bounded by the configured request timeout.

fileNodes.name: registry.py
fileNodes.summary: Maps the configured provider names to concrete LLM/embedding implementations behind lru-cached accessors, warning and degrading to MockProvider when OpenRouter credentials are absent.

fileNodes.name: main.py
fileNodes.summary: FastAPI application factory: initialises the PostgreSQL schema on startup, wires CORS, registers every API router (auth, courses, curriculum, lessons, quizzes, study plans, students, teacher, users, agent ops, logs) and exposes /health.

fileNodes.name: curriculum_memory.py
fileNodes.summary: Indexes parsed documents into pgvector-backed ContentChunks (chunking, passage embeddings, vector upserts) and links chunks to generated curriculum topics for later retrieval.

fileNodes.name: chunker.py
fileNodes.summary: Splits parsed document pages into overlapping, heading-aware text chunks carrying page ranges so retrieved passages can be cited.

fileNodes.name: embeddings.py
fileNodes.summary: Thin caching facade over the configured embedding provider: embeds single texts or batches in passage/query modes for indexing and retrieval.

fileNodes.name: parser.py
fileNodes.summary: Extracts clean per-page text from uploaded PDF, TXT/MD and DOCX course materials into a ParsedDocument structure, raising UnsupportedDocumentError for anything else.

fileNodes.name: retriever.py
fileNodes.summary: Query-side retrieval: embeds the question, runs filtered cosine search over the vector store and formats top chunks (with optional citations) into LLM context blocks.

fileNodes.name: vector_store.py
fileNodes.summary: pgvector persistence layer for course-scoped embeddings: collection DDL, idempotent ContentChunk upserts, deletion by document and cosine top-k search with dynamic metadata filters via raw SQL.

fileNodes.name: registry.py
fileNodes.summary: Tool belt exposed to agents: RAG lookup, SearXNG web search, study-plan validation, mastery updates and duplicate-question checks packaged as named Tool descriptors.

fileNodes.name: base.py
fileNodes.summary: Defines the BaseAgent abstract class every pipeline agent extends: process() hook, Pydantic validate_output, an output_is_empty hook that drives retry-on-empty, and a handle() wrapper adding timing, MessageBus status marks, and error capture into AgentResult.

fileNodes.name: curriculum_agent.py
fileNodes.summary: CurriculumAnalyzerAgent turns an uploaded course document into a structured curriculum: parses and RAG-indexes the file, prompts the LLM with the CurriculumOutput JSON schema, persists chapters/topics/objectives/prerequisites idempotently by title, and assigns indexed chunks to matching topics.

fileNodes.name: grading_agent.py
fileNodes.summary: GradingAgent grades a submitted quiz attempt: deterministic objective grading via the grading service, LLM-based short-answer grading with confidence scores, flags low-confidence subjective answers needs_teacher_review, computes the attempt score, and upserts a Grade row.

fileNodes.name: message.py
fileNodes.summary: Inter-agent messaging primitives: the AgentMessage value object and a MessageBus that persists send/mark events to the agent_messages table with duration tracking, giving observability over the multi-agent pipeline.

fileNodes.name: performance_agent.py
fileNodes.summary: PerformanceAnalysisAgent consumes a graded attempt: updates per-topic StudentMastery records, records study history, detects recurring misconceptions across recent attempts, and emits weak/strong topic lists for downstream adaptation.

fileNodes.name: planner_agent.py
fileNodes.summary: StudyPlannerAgent builds or adapts study plans deterministically: loads topics with mastery weights, delegates packing/ordering to the scheduler service (build_plan/adapt_plan), validates prerequisite ordering, packs items into days, and persists a new versioned StudyPlan.

fileNodes.name: quiz_agent.py
fileNodes.summary: QuizAgent generates assessment questions via a schema-constrained LLM prompt seeded with course context, dedupes against existing question hashes, persists Question rows, and tops up from the existing bank when generation falls short.

fileNodes.name: recommendation_agent.py
fileNodes.summary: RecommendationAgent picks the next best action (e.g. review_topic) from weak topics via _decide, then renders a learner-facing narrative using an LLM prompt with a deterministic mock fallback before persisting a Recommendation row.

fileNodes.name: supervisor.py
fileNodes.summary: Supervisor coordinates pipeline execution: classifies intents into agent action chains, starts/persists AgentTask rows, emits the initial message, routes each action to its receiver agent, and finalizes tasks.

fileNodes.name: runtime.py
fileNodes.summary: LangGraph-style AgentRuntime: registers all agents, threads a GraphState payload through supervisor-defined chains, executes each node with savepoint-backed retries (_run_with_retry with backoff and empty-output detection), and manages overall task success/failure.

fileNodes.name: logger.py
fileNodes.summary: Logging bootstrap: configures root logging once from Settings, exposes get_logger(name), and bind_task to attach task/correlation ids as contextual log fields.

fileNodes.name: grading.py
fileNodes.summary: Pure deterministic grading helpers: stable question_hash/is_duplicate dedup keys, rule-based grade_objective for MCQ/true-false/numerical answers (numeric tolerance via _numeric_equal), compute_attempt_score totals, and rubric_default prompts.

fileNodes.name: scheduler.py
fileNodes.summary: Deterministic study-plan engine: orders topics topologically over prerequisites, builds day-packed plans weighted toward low mastery and nearing exams, adapts existing plans around weak topics, and validates prerequisite ordering, coverage, and daily minute budgets.

fileNodes.name: base.py
fileNodes.summary: SQLAlchemy foundation layer providing the shared declarative Base, a pgvector-aware VectorColumn TypeDecorator, and the engine/session factory used by the entire persistence layer.

fileNodes.name: __init__.py
fileNodes.summary: Barrel module importing and re-exporting every ORM model so callers use a single adapted.models namespace for Course, Topic, QuizAttempt, and friends.

fileNodes.name: course.py
fileNodes.summary: Defines the core teaching-domain tables: teacher-owned Courses, student Enrollments joining students to courses, and uploaded Documents tracked through their parsing status for the RAG pipeline.

fileNodes.name: curriculum.py
fileNodes.summary: Curriculum hierarchy produced by the analysis agent: Chapters group ordered Topics, Topics carry prerequisites and learning objectives, and ContentChunk rows store embedded textbook passages assigned to topics for retrieval.

fileNodes.name: learning.py
fileNodes.summary: Learning-flow tables spanning versioned StudyPlans with daily items, generated Lessons and Questions, Quizzes with question assignments, student attempts carrying per-answer AI-grading and teacher-review flags, and finalized Grades.

fileNodes.name: memory.py
fileNodes.summary: Student-memory tables persisting per-topic mastery with trend history, an append-only study activity log, detected misconceptions, aggregated conversation memory, key-value learning preferences, and agent-generated recommendations.

fileNodes.name: observability.py
fileNodes.summary: Observability tables behind the Operations UI: AgentTask rows track background pipeline runs, AgentMessage logs inter-agent traffic, and AuditLog records audited user actions.

fileNodes.name: user.py
fileNodes.summary: Identity model: User accounts with hashed credentials and a role discriminator, extended by Teacher profiles (department) and Student profiles (grade level, daily study budget, timezone).

fileNodes.name: teacher.py
fileNodes.summary: Teacher-facing API router providing class rosters, course-wide analytics, per-student grade histories, an AI-grade review queue scoped to the teacher's own courses, and manual grade overrides.

fileNodes.name: student_memory.py
fileNodes.summary: Builds and maintains each student's learning state: aggregates mastery records, misconceptions, preferences, quiz attempts, conversation memory, and study history into a StudentProfile snapshot, and persists mastery updates, study events, conversations, and preference changes.

fileNodes.name: analytics.py
fileNodes.summary: Pure analytics helpers that split mastery records into weak/strong topic sets, detect recurring misconceptions from graded answers (per MCQ distractor and per topic), and roll per-student mastery maps into a class-wide topic summary.

fileNodes.name: mastery.py
fileNodes.summary: Mastery math core: exponential-moving-average mastery updates, trend computation over score history, status-label threshold bands, and MasteryRecord construction.

fileNodes.name: .env.example
fileNodes.summary: Template documenting every runtime environment variable for AdaptED: app metadata, CORS and JWT token settings, the PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL, OpenRouter chat/embedding credentials and models, EMBEDDING_DIM=2048, and SearxNG search options. Copied to the git-ignored .env that pydantic-settings reads at startup.

fileNodes.name: README.md
fileNodes.summary: Intentionally empty placeholder readme; the project's real conventions and running history are kept in AGENTS.md and PROGRESS.md instead.

fileNodes.name: opencode.json
fileNodes.summary: Configuration for the opencode CLI coding agent in this repository, using the instructions array to auto-load AGENTS.md and PROGRESS.md as instruction context for every session.

fileNodes.name: pyproject.toml
fileNodes.summary: uv/hatchling package manifest for adapted v0.1.0 declaring the FastAPI + SQLAlchemy + pgvector + Streamlit + OpenAI/LangGraph dependency stack, dev tooling (pytest with asyncio auto mode, ruff at line-length 100 / py312), and wheel packaging of the src/adapted layout.

fileNodes.name: .python-version
fileNodes.summary: Pyenv version pin selecting Python 3.12 as the interpreter for the project runtime and tooling.

fileNodes.name: .understandignore
fileNodes.summary: Generated ignore-rule configuration for the Understand-Anything analysis pipeline, excluding bytecode, env files, storage artifacts, databases, and caches while explicitly keeping docs.

fileNodes.name: __init__.py
fileNodes.summary: Package marker for the AdaptED backend declaring the project name and __version__ 0.1.0.

fileNodes.name: __init__.py
fileNodes.summary: Empty package initializer marking the API routers package; individual routers are registered directly in the FastAPI app factory.

fileNodes.name: app.py
fileNodes.summary: Streamlit frontend entrypoint providing login/register, role-based sidebar navigation, and every teacher view (dashboard, curriculum, class analytics, review queue, operations) and student view (dashboard, study plan, learn, quizzes, progress, recommendations) on top of the APIClient.

fileNodes.name: client.py
fileNodes.summary: Thin httpx-based REST client wrapping every AdaptED backend endpoint (auth, users, courses, documents, curriculum, agents/tasks, lessons, quizzes, study plans, students, teacher classes, audit logs, health) with bearer-token headers and APIError translation.
